5987e47777ffe43d.description: Job description: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (MSc. / PhD) Location: Global – Fully Remote Job Type: Contract Work Commitment: Approximately 15 hours per week Compensation: $60–$120 per hour (output-based) About the Opportunity We are working with a leading AI research and technology initiative focused on advancing the capabilities of next-generation artificial intelligence models and AI agents. Candidates should possess strong Python programming skills, practical machine learning experience, and hands-on experience using coding agents within their development workflows. Integrate coding agents into Python-based development and problem-solving workflows. Verify implementations against defined correctness, reproducibility, and performance criteria. Review code quality, technical accuracy, and adherence to project specifications. Required Qualifications A Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a closely related quantitative discipline. Strong professional or research experience in machine learning. Demonstrated proficiency in Python programming. Practical experience using coding agents in Python development workflows. Hands-on experience with machine learning model development, implementation, debugging, or optimization. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical reasoning skills. Ability to work independently and deliver high-quality technical solutions. Preferred Qualifications Experience at an established technology company, AI research laboratory, research organization, or recognized engineering environment. Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX. Familiarity with model training, inference optimization, numerical computing, and performance profiling. We welcome applications from qualified Machine Learning Engineers, Research Engineers, Applied Scientists, and ML Systems Engineers who possess strong Python coding skills, relevant postgraduate qualifications, and practical experience using coding agents. About Druva
Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. The Resilience Cloud is a fully managed, cloud-native SaaS platform that delivers air-gapped and immutable protection across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, endpoint, and edge environments. Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva’s graph-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence.

Trusted by nearly 7,500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world.

Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.

Position Summary 

The Professional Services Consultant has a responsibility to discover, design, consult, and implement Druva solutions for new and existing customers and provide best practices and guide the customer during the entire implementation cycle.  In addition, this would also include providing technical consultation on Druva’s Data Security Services and Disaster Recovery Services and conducting Cyber Simulations, Security assessments, assistance with Ransomware Recovery and Disaster Recovery Playbooks and Runbooks, configuration and integration of SIEM/SOAR tools, etc. As a member of the Professional Services team, this role will engage and drive customer success. Candidates for this pivotal position are highly dynamic and seasoned professionals with soft and technical skills.

 

As a Professional Services Consultant, you will interact with peers around the globe and be a mentor to your team. The ability to effectively scale your interactions from highly technical I.T. staff to key stakeholders at the Executive level is a must.  Flexibility in your current skill set and a demonstrable eagerness to learn new things are key criteria to any candidate for this position.

You will work in a team of individual contributors who are empowered to make decisions and run their daily business tasks. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Discover, Design, Deploy, and Optimize Druva Solutions to meet customer requirements
  • Lead end to end product deployments and configurations for all lines of business in Druva related to Enterprise Workloads, End User Protection, SaaS Applications and Ransomware and Disaster Recovery practices
  • Conduct Cyber Simulation exercises and Security assessments to test customer’s readiness to handle a cyber attack as well as identify gaps within existing security practices and provide recommendations to mitigate the same
  • Conduct Security Penetration testings
  • Assist with Incident Response Plans, Recovery Playbooks and Cyber Recovery.
  • Assist with SIEM/SOAR integrations and configurations between the Customer and Druva’s environment
  • Build Project Plans, and organize and manage all phases of a project to ensure successful implementation. This includes developing technical solutions and managing project plans, project schedules, success criteria, and milestones
  • Consult with customers and internal teams on best practices and meet expectations
  • Communicate status to key stakeholders on project status to drive the outcome
  • Timely responsiveness to customer satisfaction
  • Manage customer relationships and perform environmental health assessments of product adoption and data resiliency
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on customer requests and feature/product enhancements

Desired Skills and Experience

  • 8+ years in technical customer-facing roles with at least 2+ years as a Consultant
  • Leading and assisting the team and driving large customer implementation across all customers for Enterprise Workloads, End User protection, SaaS Applications, Ransomware Recovery, Disaster Recovery practices
  • Expert level knowledge of Operating Systems including MS Windows, Linux and Mac.
  • Experience with IDP, SSO Tools, SCCM/Casper/Jamf/intune Deployment tools, Virtual environments (VMWare, VMC, HyperV, AWS, Azure, Nutanix), Storage Technologies (SAN/NAS)
  • Knowledge of Networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, Bandwidth Management, Firewalls), Cloud Technologies using AWS/Azure/M365/Google Workspace as well as Security Solutions.
  • Fast Learner in a dynamic environment with changing priorities
  • Experience in conducting Cyber Simulation Exercises with multiple stakeholders 
  • Experience in conducting Risk Assessments
  • Experience in curating IR playbooks and runbooks
  • Experience in handling a cyber recovery process
  • Experience with automation and scripting tools such as PowerShell, Python, etc.
  • Exposure to API’s
  • Results-oriented with the ability to prioritize activities, plan and organize to meet commitments
  • Excellent presentation, communication (verbal & written), and relationship-building skills, across all levels of management including negotiations and risk abatement
  • Excellent consultative approach to customer engagements
  • Working knowledge of SaaS demonstrating deep knowledge of SaaS practices
  • Ability to work in a cross-functional team environment and collaborate with key partners to drive customer engagement and experience
  • Understanding of automation and scripting tools such as PowerShell, Python, etc would be an added advantage. .

Requirements

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise server backup technology
  • Working Knowledge and practical experience administrating Virtual Infrastructure. 
  • Backup & Restore of File, NAS, MSSQL,MYSQL, Oracle Servers, SAP HANA, AHV, VMware, EC2, Azure VM, VMC, Nutanix, EP, SFDC, M365, Gsuite etc.
  • Working Knowledge of AWS services - mainly EC2, S3, RDS, IAM & VPC.
  • Hands on experience with conducting Cyber Simulation exercises to identify security vulnerabilities and provide recommendations to mitigate the gaps 
  • Working knowledge of SIEM/SOAR tools and industry-wide ransomware recovery practices
  • Knowledge of Blue team activities and its related tasks
  • Understanding of project management methodologies and processes
  • Exposure to Storage protocols SAS, Fibre Channel, SCSI, iSCSI
  • Understanding of SaaS applications such as M365, Google Workspace, Salesforce etc.
  • Understanding of Network Technologies and protocols – TCP/IP, VLAN, DNS, switches, firewalls, routers
  • Knowledge of scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python etc.
  • CISM or Security+ certified preferred.

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Snowflake Data Engineer to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled ETL Developer with 6+ years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining modern data integration and transformation solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on expertise in Snowflake, Data Build Tool (DBT), and Fivetran, along with excellent SQL development skills. The candidate should have experience building scalable data pipelines, implementing data quality controls, and supporting enterprise data warehousing and analytics initiatives.

Additionally, the candidate should be well-versed in CI/CD practices, Git-based development workflows, and deployment automation to support modern data engineering practices.

Technical Skills

• 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering with at least 2+ years in a Snowflake and DBT.

🚀 About Nivoda
Nivoda is a fast-growing B2B marketplace that is transforming the global diamond and gemstone industry. We connect buyers and sellers across the world, processing $300M+ in annual transactions and unlocking a $350B industry opportunity. We move fast, think big, and care deeply about the businesses and people we serve.
 
🌍 Our Mission
The diamond trading industry has historically been fragmented, opaque, and inaccessible. Nivoda was founded to change that: to empower businesses of all sizes and locations to participate in a fair, efficient global marketplace. Every line of code, every integration, every automation we build brings us closer to that mission.

About the Role
We are looking for a Growth and Demand Gen Lead to own how Nivoda finds and wins new jewellers. This is a hands-on role for someone who lives in the channels and the numbers. You will run our paid, SEO, and account-based programs yourself, and you will be the person who works out which repeatable, scalable channels actually drive qualified leads, then builds them into an engine.
We do demand gen a particular way. Rather than pushing people to a product page and hoping, we lead with genuine value: free tools, content, and resources that help jewellers run better businesses, and we let that earn the relationship. Your job is to build the acquisition machine around that model and prove, channel by channel, what works.
You will start as an individual contributor with real ownership of the function, working alongside our paid, lifecycle, and GTM engineering talent. As the channels prove out and the work grows, there is a clear path to build and lead a team beneath you.
 
What would you be doing?
• 
Own net-new customer acquisition: set the demand-gen strategy, then go and execute it yourself, hands-on, across paid and beyond.
• 
Run our paid channels day to day, Google and Meta to start. For now, the ad accounts are something you are in, not something you hand off.
• 
Find and build repeatable, scalable channels that drive qualified leads. The goal is a system, not a string of one-off campaigns.
• 
Grow our SEO and AEO (answer-engine) presence, so jewellers find us when they are looking for help, not only when we are paying to reach them.
• 
Design and run account-based programs aimed at the specific jewellers we most want as customers.
• 
Lean into our value-first model: point spend at free tools and content, like our Jeweller Business Health Check, rather than product pages, and build the funnel that turns that attention into signups.
• 
Work inside our attribution from day one. Partner with our data and GTM engineering leads so every channel is measurable and every dollar is accountable.
• 
Hand qualified leads off cleanly to the SDR team, and close the loop so you know which channels produce customers, not just clicks.
• 
Raise the bar on how rigorously the whole team tests and scales growth ideas, wherever those ideas come from.
• 
Report on what is working in plain terms, kill what is not, and reinvest in what is.
 
What do we need from you?
• 
5+ years in growth or demand gen, with a track record of building acquisition channels that scaled, not just managing a spend number.
• 
Deep, hands-on paid expertise. You can build, run, and optimise Google and Meta campaigns yourself, today.
• 
Real experience across more than one channel: paid plus some mix of SEO, ABM, lifecycle, or net-new experiments.
• 
You think in systems, repeatable and measurable and scalable, and you are suspicious of any win you cannot explain or repeat.
• 
Fluency with attribution and analytics. You start from the numbers and you can defend them.
• 
Comfort as a hands-on IC on a small team, building process where none exists, with the ambition to grow into leading a team.
• 
A bias for experiments. You ship, measure, learn, and move, rather than planning forever.
• 
Happy to use AI and modern tooling to move faster.
 
Nice to have
• 
Experience acquiring small business owners, retailers, or a trade audience.
• 
A marketplace, self-serve, or product-led growth background.
• 
Hands-on with the tools in our stack: Google Ads, Meta, HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay, and Mixpanel.
• 
Experience with a value-first or content-led acquisition model.
• 
Real SEO and AEO depth as search shifts toward AI-generated answers.
 
🌟 Our culture and what we offer
We're a high-growth company in an exponential expansion phase. We move fast, operate with low hierarchy, and give people real ownership from day one. If you want to work somewhere you can genuinely shape things: not just maintain them: Nivoda is the place.
 
Our current benefits
• 
🕐 Flexible working hours and vibrant company culture
• 
🏡 Remote work
• 
📈 Opportunities for growth and learning
• 
🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance
• 
🚀 Chance to join during our exponential expansion phase
 
Equal Opportunity
Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let that stop you from applying: we hire for potential and mindset, not just a checklist.
Please submit your CV in English.
 
Not quite the right role?
If this role isn't for you but you're excited about Nivoda, join our Talent Pool and we'll reach out when something's a better fit: nivoda.com/talent-pool

Effective communication, risk management, and governance will be key aspects of your role, along with leading the Go-Live activities and coordinating planning and preparation for deployment.Responsibilities: Developing and maintaining the release management process, including the coordination of all aspects of the release lifecycle. Collaborate with development, QA, and infrastructure teams to ensure proper testing, documentation, and scheduling. Supporting training and communication as part of change management. Activities may include designing or delivering specialized training resources to appropriate resources. Own the entire change and release lifecycle, collaborating with development, QA, and infrastructure teams to guarantee proper testing, documentation, and scheduling. Lead and co-ordinate the Go-Live activities including the execution of the deployment Plans and checklists. Release management allows for distinctive but connected aspects of a project like design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, and more. Acts as process owner for the change management process. Leads the assessment and analysis of change based on requests for change. Regular communication and updates ensure everyone stays informed and accountable throughout the Salesforce release process.Mandatory Skills Description: 7+ years of experience as a Release Manager Banking domain experience is mandatory Experience in Azure Devops (ADO) Pipeline and ADO Boards experience. Experience in Container, Docker, ServiceNow, Cloud based integration/deployment Hands-on experience supporting CI/CD pipelines and integrating automation workflow Solid understanding of databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and ability to integrate DB automation into releases Experience integrating security and compliance scans into release processes Experience documenting processes using Confluence, Jira, or similar tools Familiarity with AI-driven automation concepts in release and deployment processes .
